description: This file contains scripts for analyzing TypeScript source code to find channel-agnostic boundary violations, such as improper module imports, configuration references, and literal usages associated with specific channels. It utilizes the TypeScript compiler API to parse and traverse source files, detect violations, and enforce project boundaries related to channel handling.

methods.name: findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes source code to find violations related to channel module imports, configuration path references, channel comparisons, and assignments that violate boundary rules.

methods.name: findChannelCoreReverseDependencyViolations
methods.description: Checks for violations in core channel dependencies, ignoring some checks like configuration and comparison violations.

methods.name: findAcpUserFacingChannelNameViolations
methods.description: Detects uses of channel names in user-facing text outside of module specifiers, which may violate visibility or localization rules.

methods.name: findSystemMarkLiteralViolations
methods.description: Finds hardcoded system mark literals in source, which are discouraged for maintainability.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Runs the violation detection process across relevant source files and reports violations.
